method_log.shrinkage_intensity_note: lambda_corr is dominant shrinkage parameter. lambda=0 means raw sample cor, lambda=1 means identity target (no off-diag correlation).

sigma_estimator.selection_rationale: Sample Σ cond=21.70 well below 100. n=135 above LW threshold (~60). Preserve raw correlation structure for regime-conditional analysis. LW lambda_corr=0.80 would shrink raw cor (-0.12, +0.08, +0.12) → (-0.02, +0.01, +0.02) losing regime signal.
